privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: KVKK / GDPR rights on this instance. Prompt is not policy. The Go engine owns dice.
privacy.storeBody: Email, password hash, optional device license, rooms and characters you create, compiled universe packs you own. Persistence is in-memory until Postgres/Mongo land — a process restart wipes the instance.
privacy.llmBody: No paid third-party LLM or image APIs. Storyteller and mechanics are our stubs (and later our adapters on our machines). Weights never go in git. Player logs are not training data.
privacy.rightsBody: Export a machine-readable copy of your record. Erase the account. After erase, the session cookie is cleared and the JWT no longer maps to a user.
privacy.notBody: Not a law firm letter. Not email delivery. Not a live production DPA. Operators of each instance keep certificates and production secrets out of git.

account.title: Your account
account.lead: Export or erase. Erase cannot be undone on this instance.
